meta.title: Reviewing with an outside address bounces back the same way
gaps: Log in to Asha's mailbox and open the Procol approval email
Click Review, add the external recipient and comment, and send without changing the subject
Wait for Procol to process the mailbox message
Verify that no review was created in the approval workflow
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Log in to Asha's mailbox and open the Procol approval email; Click Review, add the external recipient and comment, and send without changing the subject; Wait for Procol to process the mailbox message; Verify that no review was created in the approval workflow

args.need: log in to Asha's mailbox, open the Procol approval request, click Review, enter a comment and outsider.qa@gmail.com as the recipient without changing the subject, send it, wait for Procol to process the mailbox, and leave the bounce-back visible

steps.note: The catalog has no mailbox or email-sending workflow, so the tester must perform the external-recipient review flow.

args.text: We could not send your review because outsider.qa@gmail.com is not part of your organisation on Procol

steps.note: Assert the expected bounce-back message is visible after the tester completes the email flow.
